General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Recline Mechanisms that connect the outside portions of the Seat Back to the Seat Cushion
Allows for tilting of the Seat Back in both a forward and reverse direction
Includes Drivers and Passengers Sides
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Seat Recline Mechanism – RH Side (Passengers Side)
Qty 1 – Seat Recline Mechanism – LH Side (Drivers Side)
Qty 1 – Seat Recline Mechanism Cover – RH Side (Passengers Side)
Qty 1 – Seat Recline Mechanism Cover – LH Side (Drivers Side)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
